===White Dragonscale Armor===
By turning in 20 [[White Dragon Scale]]s to [[Rukts]] (Master White Scalesmith of the Runetusk Tribe), he will craft you one of these:
* {{Item|White Dragonhide Armor}}
* {{Item|White Dragonplate Armor}}
* {{Item|White Dragonscale Armor}}
* {{Item|White Dragonscale Docent}}
* {{Item|White Dragonscale Robe}}

See also: [[Dragonscale Armor]] (comparison of all dragonscale options)
